item.description: Attachment management via {{gatewayUrl}}: multipart upload, metadata, streaming download/thumbnail, list/filter, and soft delete. S3 is never exposed to clients.
item.name: AttachmentsController

request.description: Upload a file via multipart/form-data. Body tab: form-data - select a local file for the file field. Saves attachmentId to the environment.
Upload a company logo via multipart/form-data (category=logo, logoVariant=full|compact|icon|favicon). Generates variant and supersedes prior logo rows.
Stream/download attachment bytes (supports Range requests for video/audio).
Get attachment metadata including application download/thumbnail URLs (no S3 URLs).

query.description: Sort direction: Asc or Desc. Default: Asc.
Free-text search across searchable fields. Optional.

request.description: Paginated attachment list with dynamic filters and sorting.
Bulk soft delete attachments for an entity (optional category filter).
Development helper: validates the Bearer token and returns the validation error, if any.
